rules: How to Play
2by2 is a daily game that offers 8 ways to win and a top prize of $22,000. Or play 2by2 Tuesday and purchase a 7-day ticket to double any prize won on Tuesday with a top prize of $44,000*.

You can purchase 2by2 tickets online any time by selecting the Buy Now button and adding tickets to your shopping cart. When making your purchase online, you can select Quick Pick to have numbers automatically selected for you, choose Create My Own Ticket to select your own lucky numbers, play Same As Last Time to recreate your last ticket, or select Subscribe so you never miss a draw.
To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards.
Ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards. Each board costs $1. Each board contains two sets of numbers from 1 through 26.

To play a board, pick two numbers from the first set of 26 numbers in the Red play area and two numbers from the second set of 26 numbers in the White play area. Place a heavy, vertical mark through the numbers you wish to play. Do not use red ink and do not erase.
You may purchase the same boards for up to 28 consecutive draws on one single ticket when you check the appropriate number of draws in the multi-draw box.

You may select QP and have the computer randomly pick the numbers for you. Either mark the QP option on the play slip for up to five boards and your desired multi-draw option or ask the store clerk for a QP ticket for up to 10 boards and your desired multi-draw option.
Tickets cannot be cancelled after issued. You are responsible for the selection of your numbers and options, not the retailer nor the Lottery.
Match at least one number and win! It's that easy and all prizes are paid in one lump sum.
* All Tuesday prizes will be doubled ONLY for a qualifying play. A qualifying Tuesday play requires a ticket purchase of 7 consecutive days or multiples of 7 consecutive days (14, 21, and 28).

primaryDescription: The Lottery computer system randomly draws 20 numbers every 4 minutes and displays them on the lottery games monitor. The Bull's-eye number is shown highlighted separately from the first 20 numbers. Keno tickets can be checked by a Lottery retailer, the Lottery website by draw number or, on a Check-A-Ticket machine.
Multiply the game prize for a $1 play by the wagered amount to determine total prize won.
qualifications: *Progressive jackpots - Players can win even bigger prizes in the 6-, 7- and 8-spot Keno games. Match 6 of 6, Match 7 of 7 or Match 8 of 8 in either the 6-, 7- or 8-spot games and win the top prize in the game PLUS the jackpot bonus prize for that game (shown on Keno monitors).

The maximum prize per ticket for matching 10 of 10 in the 10-spot basic Keno game is $100,000, which is increased by $200,000 if the Bull’s-eye option is played and that number is one of those 10 numbers. (No ticket value should exceed $300,000 for any options played.) Additionally, if a $5 wager is made on a 9 of 9 in the 9-spot basic Keno game, the prize will be limited to $100,000 and will be increased by $200,000 if the Bull’s-eye option is played and that number is one of those 9 numbers.

All Keno prizes including Bull’s-eye prizes shall be the prizes set forth except when the prize in any game from a 5-spot game through a 10-spot game exceeds $599 where total prizes for that game and the prize category for a single draw exceed $1,500,000. If that occurs, prizes shall be calculated on a pari-mutuel basis.
rules: How to Play
Keno excitement is every 4 minutes! Win even bigger prizes with Bull's-eye and progressive jackpots.
To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip.
Ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket with a maximum of one board or fill out a play slip and choose how many "spots" (numbers) you want to play per game. Choose from 1 to 10 spots.

Choose how much you want to wager per game: $1, $2, $3, $4 or $5. Your wager will affect the prize amounts you win. Just multiply the game prize for a $1 play by the wagered amount to determine total prize won. The highest prize you can win is $300,000.

You may choose to play the Bull's-eye option for a chance to win larger prizes. If you play Bull's-eye, your wager amount is doubled. Match any of your numbers chosen to the Bull's-eye and win the appropriate Keno and Bull's-eye prize.

On the play slip pick your numbers from 1 through 80 by placing a heavy vertical mark through the numbers. The numbers you pick must be equal in number to the number of spots you have selected to play. Or mark QP and the computer will randomly pick the numbers for you. Do not use red ink or erase a mark on a play slip.
Select how many consecutive games you want to play. Choose from 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 20, 50, or 100 consecutive games.
Present your completed play slip to your Lottery retailer who will give you your ticket.

rules: How to Play
Lotto America® jackpots start at $2 million. There are 9 ways to win and if you purchase the Lotto America All Star Bonus®, you could win $100,000 without even hitting the jackpot.

You can purchase Lotto America tickets online any time by selecting the Buy Now button and adding tickets to your shopping cart. To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards.

rules: How to Play
Pick 3 is a Kansas-only game with a top prize of $500. Play TWO times daily for a chance to win cash seven days a week for a total of 14 Pick 3 drawings each week.

You can purchase Pick 3 tickets online any time by selecting the Buy Now button and adding tickets to your shopping cart. When making your purchase online, you can select Quick Pick to have numbers automatically selected for you, choose Create My Own Ticket to select your own lucky numbers, play Same As Last Time to recreate your last ticket, or select Subscribe so you never miss a draw.
To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards.

Ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards. Each board contains three columns of numbers 0 through 9. Select one number from each column. You can pick the same number once, twice or three times, or you can choose three different numbers. If you want the computer to randomly select your numbers, mark "Quick Pick" at the bottom of the board
Select your play type "Exact Order" or "Any Order"
Exact Order (straight): For $1 wager, if the three numbers drawn match your numbers in the exact order, you win $500

Any Order (3-way box): For a $1 wager, if the three numbers drawn match you numbers in any order, you win $80. Win $160 for matching your three numbers in any order when two or three of the three numbers selected are IDENTICAL
Select "MID" (Midday), "EVE" (Evening) or "BOTH" (Both) depending on the draw(s) for which you want your play to be eligible.
Each draw is a $1 wager. For example, if you select "MID" or "EVE" only, your wager will cost $1 per board played. If you select "BOTH" your wager will cost $2 per board played.

DO NOT USE RED INK; use only blue or black ink, or pencil. If a square is marked in error choose "VOID" for that board and move to the next board. DO NOT ERASE. Check the play slip carefully before presenting it to the retailer

If you wish, you may purchase the same boards, play types and wager for either 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 14, 21, or 28 consecutive draws by marking the appropriate number of draws in the "MULTI-DRAW" area at the left side of the play slip. "MULTI-DRAW" option applies to all boards played

Before submitting the play slip, make sure the numbers, play type, wager and time of draw(s) and any multi-draw options are the ones you want. RESPONSIBILITY FOR YOUR NUMBERS AND WAGERS RESTS WITH YOU, NOT THE RETAILER OR THE LOTTERY. Any liability of the Kansas Lottery is limited to the cost of ticket purchased.

rules: How to Play

Powerball® jackpots start at $20 million. There are 9 ways to win and if you match the first 5 numbers with Power Play®, you are guaranteed a $2 million cash prize! You may also have a second chance to win each night if you purchase the Double Play® option.

You can purchase Powerball tickets online any time by selecting the Buy Now button and adding tickets to your shopping cart. When making your purchase online, you can select Quick Pick to have numbers automatically selected for you, choose Create My Own Ticket to select your own lucky numbers, play Same As Last Time to recreate your last ticket, or select Subscribe so you never miss a draw.
To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards.
Each Powerball play costs $2 and numbers are drawn from two sets of numbers: one set from 1 through 69 and the second set from 1 through 26.

To play, pick five numbers from the set of 69 numbers, and one number (the Powerball number) from the set of 26 numbers. When creating your own ticket online or using a play slip at retail, fill in or select the squares from the numbers you wish to play. If using a play slip at retail, do not used red ink or erase. If you make an error on the retail play slip mark the VOID square, and them make selections on another board.

If you want to play the Power Play, mark the Power Play square. The Power Play number will be selected before each Powerball draw and depending upon the number selected, your non-jackpot prize winnings will be multiplied by 2, 3, 4, 5, or 10, except the $1 million dollar prize that will be doubled. The Power Play costs an additional $1 per board played.

If you want to play the Double Play, mark the Double Play square. Choosing Double Play costs an additional $1 per board played on the play slip. The Double Play drawing will be held after the scheduled Powerball drawing and offers an additional chance to win on your original numbers by matching a new set of numbers drawn.

To have the terminal randomly pick the numbers for you at retail, either mark the QP option on the play slip for up to five boards and your desired multi-draw option or ask the stork clerk for a QP ticket for up to five boards and your desired multi-draw option ($2 per board played, plus an additional $1 for Power Play if selected and an additional $1 for Double Play if selected).
Both Power Play and Double Play features can be selected for the Powerball ticket, however, the Power Play multiplier does not apply to the prizes won in the Double Play drawing.
* The 10X multiplier will only be used when the advertised annuitized jackpot is $150 million or less.

** The Match 5 prize will NOT be multiplied and will remain at $2 million for a Match 5+0 win when the Power Play option is purchased as an add-on to the Powerball play. The Jackpot prize is not included in the Power Play multiplier option.

rules: How to Play
*Racetrax® games are available for purchase and can be played at ANY Kansas Lottery retailer!
Racetrax® features:
12 horses per race, with each race lasting up to one minute.
Races beginning every 4 ½ minutes.
A Bonus Wheel that spins before each race giving players a chance to multiply their winnings.
Each of the horses that participates in the game has a fixed probability of winning the race.
Winning numbers that are randomly generated and displayed on TV monitors.
Available at all retailer locations across the state.
Many ways to play and win!
Playing Racetrax®
Completing a Racetrax® play slip is easy. Just use a pencil or blue or black ink, and make heavy marks in the boxes for the options you want to play.
Play every 4 ½ minutes from 4:00 AM to 2:50 AM every day.
Step 1 – Select a Bet Type:

Use Section 1 of your play slip to mark which bet type you wish to play. There are 12 horses in every race. Select only one bet type and the horse(s) of your choice, or mark the "Quick Pick" [QP] box.
Quick Pick is not available for Wheel bets.
WIN: Select at least one horse to finish in 1st place (Minimum bet per ticket = $1)
SHOW: Select at least one horse to finish in 1st, 2nd or 3rd place. (Minimum bet per ticket = $1)
WIN/SHOW: A WIN/SHOW is a combined WIN and SHOW bet on one ticket. One horse equals two bets. (Minimum bet per ticket = $2)
If your horse finishes 1st, you win the WIN and the SHOW prizes.
If your horse finishes 2nd or 3rd, you win the SHOW prize only.
EXACTA: Select two horses that will finish in 1st & 2nd place in EXACT order. (Minimum bet amount = $1)

EXACTA BOX: Select at least two horses to finish in 1st & 2nd place in ANY order. The number of wagers in an Exacta Box for one race is equal to the number of all possible combinations based on the total number of horses selected. Two horses equal two bets. (Base bet amount = $1, Minimum bet amount = $2)

EXACTA WHEEL: Select three or more horses (at least one in each box) to finish 1st & 2nd in EXACT order. Quick Pick (QP) is not available for the Exacta Wheel bet type. If more than three horses are selected, the cost for one race will be determined by the total number of all possible combinations. (Base bet amount = $1, Minimum bet per ticket = $2)
QUINELLA: Select two or more horses to finish in 1st and 2nd place in ANY order. (Minimum bet per ticket =$1)
TRIFECTA: Select three horses that will finish in 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in EXACT order. (Minimum bet per ticket = $1)

TRIFECTA BOX: Select at least three horses that will finish in 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in ANY order. The number of wagers in a Trifecta Box for one race is equal to the number of all possible combinations based on the total number of horses selected. Three horses equal six (6) bets. (Base bet amount = $.50, Minimum bet per ticket = $3)

TRIFECTA WHEEL: Select four or more horses (at least one in each box) to finish in 1st, 2nd and 3rd place in EXACT order. Quick Pick (QP) is not available for Trifecta Wheel bet type. If more than four horses are selected, the total number of all possible combinations will determine the cost for one race. (Minimum bet per ticket = $2)
SUPERFECTA: Select four horses that will place 1st, 2nd, 3rd & 4th in EXACT order. (Minimum bet per ticket = $1)

SUPERFECTA BOX: Select at least four horses to place 1st, 2nd, 3rd & 4th in ANY order. The number of wagers in a Superfecta Box for one race is equal to the number of all possible combinations based on the total number of horses selected. Four horses equals 24 bets. (Base bet amount =$.10, Minimum bet per ticket = $2.40)

SUPERFECTA WHEEL: Select at least five horses to finish 1st, 2nd, 3rd & 4th in EXACT order. Quick Pick (QP) is not available for the Superfecta Wheel bet type. If more than five horses are selected, the cost for one race will be determined by the total number of all possible combinations. (Base bet amount = $.10, Minimum bet per ticket = $1)
WIN, SHOW, QUINELLA, EXACTA & TRIFECTA bet types: Maximum prize liability is $1,000,000 per race. The maximum prize liability when there are bonus winners is $1,575,000.

There is a $315,000 maximum prize per race on any one Racetrax® ticket when Racetrax® Bonus is not selected, or when Racetrax® Bonus is selected and "No Bonus" occurs on the Bonus Wheel. The maximum prize per race on any one Racetrax® ticket when Racetrax® Bonus is selected and a bonus is won is $1,575,000. When maximum liability per race per bet type exceeds these stated levels, the prizes shall be calculated on a pari-mutuel basis.
SUPERFECTA bet type: The maximum prize liability is $650,248 per race. The maximum prize liability when there are bonus winners is $1,950,744.

The maximum prize per race on any one ticket without Racetrax® Bonus is $650,248 and $1,950,744 with Racetrax® Bonus. When maximum liability per race per bet type exceeds these stated levels, the prizes shall be calculated on a pari-mutuel basis.
Step 2 – Select your Horse(s):
Use Section 2 of your play slip to select your horses OR mark the Quick Pick (QP) box if you want your horses selected for you. Quick Pick is NOT available for the Trifecta and Superfecta Wheel bets.
WIN, SHOW, WIN/SHOW: Select at least one horse in the 1st box.
EXACTA: Select two individual horses, one in each of the 1st and 2nd boxes.
EXACTA BOX: Select at least two horses in the 1st box.
EXACTA WHEEL: Select three or more horses, at least one in each of the 1st and 2nd boxes.
QUINELLA: Select at least two horses, at least one in each of the 1st and 2nd boxes.
TRIFECTA: Select three different individual horses, one in each of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd boxes.
TRIFECTA BOX: Select at least three horses in the 1st box.
TRIFECTA WHEEL: Select four or more horses, at least one in each of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd boxes.
SUPERFECTA: Select four different individual horses, one in each of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th boxes.
SUPERFECTA BOX: Select at least four horses in the 1st box.
SUPERFECTA WHEEL: Select five or more horses, at least one in each of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th boxes.
Step 3 – Select your Bet Amount:

Use Section 3 of your play slip to select the amount you wish to bet per Race ($.10, $.50, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $10 or $20). Examples are based on the minimum ticket cost for one race. The total cost of your ticket will equal:
WIN or SHOW = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Horses Selected]
WIN/SHOW = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Horses Selected] X [2]
EXACTA = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Horses Selected]
EXACTA BOX = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Possible Bet Combinations]

(Two is the number of bets in an Exacta Box if only two horses are selected. If more than two horses are selected, the cost will increase by $1 for each additional possible combination. For example, if three horses are selected, there are six possible combinations for a cost of $6.)
EXACTA WHEEL = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Possible Bet Combinations]
(For example, if the number one horse is selected in Box 1, and the two and four horses in Box 2, there are two possible combinations, 1-2 and 1-4. The cost based on a $1 bet, would be $2.)
QUINELLA = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races]

(If more than two horses are selected, each additional horse will increase the cost by $1 for each set of possible Quinella finishes. For example, if the 1 and 2 horses are selected, the set would be 1-2, 2-1, and the minimum cost would be $1. If horses 1, 2 and 3 are selected, the set would be 1-2, 2-1; 1-3, 3-1; 2-3, 3-2, so the minimum cost would be $3, $1 for each for the three sets.)
TRIFECTA = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races]
TRIFECTA BOX = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Possible Bet Combinations]

(Six is the number of bets in a Trifecta Box if only three horses are selected. If more than three horses are selected, the cost will increase by $.50 for each additional possible combination. For example, if four horses are selected, there are 24 possible combinations for a cost of $12.)
TRIFECTA WHEEL = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Possible Bet Combinations]

(For example, if the number one and number two horses are selected in Box 1, the number three horse in Box 2 and the number four horse in Box 3, there are two possible combinations, 1-3-4 and 2-3-4. The cost, based on a $.50 bet, would be $1.)
SUPERFECTA = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races]
SUPERFECTA BOX = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] X [Number of Possible Bet Combinations]

(Base bet amount is $.10. There are 24 bets in a Superfecta Box if only four horses are selected. If more than four horses are selected, the cost will increase by $.10 for each additional possible combination. For example, if five horses are selected, there are 120 possible combinations for a cost of $12.)
SUPERFECTA WHEEL = [Bet Amount] X [Number of Races] x [Number of Possible Bet Combinations].

(For example, if the number one horse is selected in Box 1, the number two horse is selected in Box 2, the number three horse is selected in Box 3 and the number four and five horses are selected in Box 4, there are two possible combinations 1-2-3-4 and 1-2-3-5. The cost on a $0.50 bet would be $1. The base bet for this bet type is $0.10 – the minimum required wager is $1.)
Step 4 – Select Number of Races:
In Section 4, select the number of consecutive races you wish to play (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10 or 20.)
Step 5 – Do you want to play Racetrax® Bonus?

If you would like to play Racetrax® Bonus, select "Yes" on your play slip for the Racetrax® Bonus option and have the chance to multiply your winnings on every race. You must play Racetrax® if you want to play Racetrax® Bonus. Selecting "Yes" will double the cost of your ticket. If you do not wish to play Racetrax® Bonus, then select "No."
* The maximum wager per ticket for Racetrax® when Racetrax® Bonus is not played is $120 per ticket.
* The maximum wager per ticket for Racetrax® when Racetrax® Bonus is played is $240 per ticket.
How to play Racetrax® Bonus

Racetrax® Bonus is a feature of Racetrax® that gives you a chance to increase your Racetrax® winnings by up to 10 times the original amount. Simply mark the "Yes" box for Racetrax® Bonus on your Racetrax® play slip.

Determining your Racetrax® Bonus wager is easy. It is the same amount that you wagered on Racetrax®. For instance, if you wager $2 on Racetrax®, then your Racetrax® Bonus wager is an additional $2, for a total ticket cost of $4.

Racetrax® Bonus draws first, with a wheel that spins and stops to reveal which multiplier, if any, applies to the next Racetrax® race. Possible multipliers are as follows: No Bonus, 3X, 4X, 5X, and 10X. It is also possible there will be no multiplier for the race. Then the race takes place. If your ticket is a winner for the Racetrax® race, and you also played Racetrax® Bonus, then multiply the amount you won by the Racetrax® Bonus multiplier, if any. The result is how much money you will actually collect. For example, if you win $7 on Racetrax®, and the multiplier for that race is 3, then you collect $21. If the multiplier is 4, you collect $28, and so on.

You can watch the race at select retailer locations. You can also use the Ticket Checker machine at any Kansas Lottery retailer to see if you won.   Click on 'THE ODDS' tab to see all the ways to win playing Racetrax®!

With Racetrax® Bonus, you can win up to $1,575,000 for WIN, WIN/SHOW, SHOW, QUINELLA, EXACTA, and TRIFECTA bets, or $1,950,744 for a SUPERFECTA bet on Racetrax® when the Racetrax® Bonus option is selected and a specific multiplier occurs!

rules: How to Play
Super Kansas Cash is a Kansas-only game with jackpots starting at $100,000. There are 8 ways to win. You get 2 plays for $1 and a jackpot that pays in 1 lump sum.
To purchase tickets at retail, ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has five boards.
Ask the store clerk for a Quick Pick (QP) ticket or fill out a play slip. Each play slip has six boards. Play any two boards for $1. Play up to six boards for $3.

To play a board, pick five numbers from the set of 32 numbers and pick one number from the set of 25 numbers. Each play is a minimum of two  boards. You can play two, four, or six boards on a play slip. Place a heavy, vertical mark through the numbers you wish to play. Do not use red ink and do not erase. If you make an error, mark the VOID box, and then make selections on another board.
You may purchase the same boards for up to 15 consecutive draws on one single ticket when you check the appropriate number of draws in the multi-draw box.

You may select QP and have the computer randomly pick the numbers for you. Either mark the QP option on the play slip for up to six boards and your desired multi-draw option or ask the store clerk for a QP ticket for up to ten boards and your desired multi-draw option.
